confirmed.claim: open-as-lane anchors each placement 'after' its target predecessor, so the lane only reproduces v<n> when its changes are accepted in list order. The spec allows accepting each change on its own, in any order. Accepted in a different order, main ends up in an order that is not v<n>, the lane closes as if it succeeded, and no orphan is reported.

Accepting them in reverse through POST /api/lanes/:id/changes/:c/accept gives 200 each time, final main order [s1,s5,s4,s3,s2] (≠ v1's [s1,s2,s3,s4,s5]), and the lane status is 'closed'.

Every accept returns 200. Main ends as [s1,s5,s4,s3,s2], which is not v1's order, and the lane closes with every change marked accepted and no orphan reported.
